mechanism:
Inspect the current exclusion zone, scene tree, unfinished schedule, and navigable free space. Find every remaining navigating-agent goal that cannot be reached while respecting the zone, including both goals whose arrival regions are covered and goals lost through route obstruction.

Edit the scene tree so the actual goal-bearing geometry for those unfinished operations is placed where each required arrival region has an exclusion-compliant, navigably reachable approach. Preserve the assembly relationships needed by the affected unfinished nodes. Depending on what the geometry permits, this may relocate affected unfinished placements, move a containing sub-assembly, or translate the build placement; the particular method is open. Merely adding a waypoint or moving only the navigation target while leaving the required deposit or work destination inside the zone does not satisfy the effect.

After the edit, no unfinished node may remain unclosable because a required navigating agent must enter or cross the exclusion zone. The schedule DAG itself need not be reordered, and the tool performs no assignment commit or MILP solve; the harness re-solves assignments afterward.

Precondition: at least one collision-free, exclusion-compliant placement exists that preserves the required assembly relations and makes all remaining required navigation feasible. The tool consumes intervention time and normal motion/planning energy, but no body spare or battery courier. The scene-tree edit can be undone before actions depend on the new placements; after cargo is deposited or assembly work occurs there, reversal is not generally atomic and may require further physical relocation.
impl_code:
function relocate_unreachable_goal_geometry!(env)
    zone_keys = [first(zone) for zone in active_restriction_zones()]
    isempty(zone_keys) && return (; status = :success)

    before = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)
    before.n_blocked == 0 && return (; status = :success)

    restaged = restage_all_blocked!(env; zone_keys = zone_keys)
    after_restage = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)

    incomplete_restage = restaged.status in (:infeasible, :partial, :residual_blocked)
    translated_status = :not_needed
    if incomplete_restage || after_restage.n_blocked != 0
        translated = translate_whole_build!(env; zone_keys = zone_keys)
        translated_status = translated.status
    end

    final_blockage = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)
    final_blockage.n_blocked == 0 || error("scene relocation left $(final_blockage.n_blocked) navigation goals blocked; restaging=$(restaged.status), translation=$(translated_status)")

    return (; status = :success)
end
